description: Tool to retrieve a single CustomDimension by its resource name. Use when you need detailed information about a specific custom dimension including its display name, scope, and parameter name.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving a single CustomDimension.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the CustomDimension to retrieve. Must be in the exact format: properties/{property_id}/customDimensions/{customDimension_id} where both property_id and customDimension_id are numeric identifiers. IMPORTANT: Must start with 'properties/' prefix, contain exactly one '/customDimensions/' segment, have no trailing slashes, and no additional path segments. Valid example: 'properties/489591273/customDimensions/13661238280'. Invalid examples: '489591273/13661238280' (missing prefix), 'properties/489591273/customDimensions/13661238280/' (trailing slash), 'properties/489591273/customDimensions/13661238280/extra' (extra segments)
name.title: Name

inputSchema.title: GetCustomDimensionRequest

name: get_custom_dimension

GetCustomDimensionResponse.description: Response model for GetCustomDimension action representing a CustomDimension resource.

description.description: Description for this custom dimension. Max length of 150 characters.
description.title: Description

disallowAdsPersonalization.description: If set to true, sets this dimension as NPA and excludes it from ads personalization. This is currently only supported by user-scoped custom dimensions.
disallowAdsPersonalization.title: Disallow Ads Personalization

displayName.description: Display name for this custom dimension as shown in the Analytics UI. Max length of 82 characters, alphanumeric plus space and underscore starting with a letter.
displayName.title: Display Name

name.description: Resource name of this CustomDimension. Format: properties/{property}/customDimensions/{customDimension}
name.title: Name

parameterName.description: Immutable tagging parameter name for this custom dimension. If this is a user-scoped dimension, then this is the user property name. If this is an event-scoped dimension, then this is the event parameter name. If this is an item-scoped dimension, then this is the parameter name found in the eCommerce items array.
parameterName.title: Parameter Name

scope.description: Immutable scope of this dimension. Values: DIMENSION_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED, EVENT, USER, ITEM
scope.title: Scope

GetCustomDimensionResponse.title: GetCustomDimensionResponse
